verdict.rationale: Supabase ships its own AI Assistant inside the Dashboard. It generates SQL from specifications, analyzes SQL errors and suggests fixes, and gives table-context recommendations, so there is in-product AI suggestion capability. The documented focus is schema design and SQL help rather than insights drawn from the user's actual data. Advisors are deterministic checks, and MCP serves external agents, so neither counts as in-product AI insight. Missing for 10: documented AI-generated insights or analysis of the data itself (trends, summaries, anomalies), depth of the data-aware recommendations, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
